asm.range: The value must be between {{min}} and {{max}}
asm.targetRange: The target is too far away (offset must be between {{min}} and {{max}})
asm.targetOdd: The target must be at an even offset
asm.liGrew: The value {{value}} needs two instructions, but "li" was laid out as one: its symbol changed after this line (a later .set); use the final value or another symbol

halt.ebreak: ebreak at {{pc}} (no trap handler: mtvec was not set)
halt.ecall: The program called ecall at {{pc}} (a7 = {{a7}}; no trap handler: mtvec was not set)
halt.interrupt: An interrupt arrived but there is no trap handler (mtvec was not set)
halt.illegalCsr: CSR {{csr}} at {{pc}} does not exist or is read-only
halt.misalignedFetch: The program counter {{pc}} is not a multiple of 4
halt.misalignedJump: Jump at {{pc}} to {{target}}, which is not a multiple of 4
